question: In Linear: In the Web team, set the priority to Urgent for the Design system audit issue that Sam Rivera is subscribed to. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:
There isn't one. The only "Design system audit" issue in the Web team is **WEB-4**, and its sole subscriber is Dana Whitfield — Sam Rivera isn't subscribed to it (he's not subscribed to anything else in the team either, aside from WEB-5 "Refactor design tokens" which has no subscribers at all).

If you'd like, I can still set WEB-4's priority to Urgent, or add Sam Rivera to it — just say the word.
